title: clinopodium albanicum
intro: Clinopodium albanicum, commonly known as Albanian pennyroyal, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. This herb is used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its use as an antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory agent to alleviate issues such as menstrual cramps and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium albanicum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, among others. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and potential applications.
